name: ai_tank_hostile
_comment: Wave 7, gövt 0x0010: distance vs damage rate at the 25% crossing. The AI 3 AI Tank Disc of gövt 368 (0x0010 retreat + 0x0004 always attacks the player, so it closes unprovoked) starts beside the player (mïsn 1012, pilots w7_ret_near*) or 1800 px out at Kit Jam Far's marker (mïsn 1013, w7_ret_far*). The player (Kit Lancer Heavy) holds the Kit Long Beam (15 per beam frame, about 120/s) or Long Beam 50 (about 400/s), 1500 px reach, from the first second. Panels about every 3.7 s; radar_blips.mjs gives the tank's distance off screen.
